source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Whenever this unit carries out a **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**, terrain features and models other than **TITANIC** models do not block it. During that move it can enter [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of an enemy model but cannot finish the move there, and it passes any [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape) automatically.
